synthesis_note: SRLs are used to synthesize the insights collected from the TRLs, ORLs and CRLs

crl.label: Recognition
crl.description: The citizen recognises the innovation and its potential relevance to their needs, interests, rights, everyday life, or community.

crl.label: Awareness
crl.description: The citizen becomes aware of the innovation’s intended purpose and identifies potential benefits, concerns, risks, or impacts that may be relevant to them or their community.

crl.label: Understanding
crl.description: The citizen understands the basic functioning and purpose of the innovation and its potential benefits, costs, risks, and societal implications, enabling them to form and express an informed opinion.

crl.label: Engagement
crl.description: The citizen engages with the innovation by participating in consultations, surveys, workshops, simulations, demonstrations, or similar activities and communicates their needs, concerns, expectations, and preferences.

crl.label: Co-design
crl.description: The citizen contributes to the co-design and refinement of the innovation by proposing, discussing, and prioritising use cases, requirements, safeguards, or conditions for its deployment.

crl.label: Active participation
crl.description: The citizen participates in real-world demonstrations and deliberative processes, evaluates experienced or realistically demonstrated benefits, risks, and trade-offs, and provides evidence-based feedback on the innovation and its deployment.

crl.label: Influence
crl.description: The citizen influences the development and deployment of the innovation through participation and feedback that demonstrably contribute to changes in solutions, plans, policies, safeguards, or implementation decisions.

crl.label: Empowerement
crl.description: The citizen exercises meaningful agency through established mechanisms for participating in decisions concerning the deployment, governance, monitoring, evaluation, and adaptation of the innovation.

crl.label: Sustained co-governance
crl.description: The citizen co-governs the innovation through sustained participation in its monitoring, evaluation, adaptation, and evolution, with established mechanisms ensuring that citizen needs, values, rights, and diverse perspectives continue to influence its operation and future development.

srl.label: Need identified
srl.description: Identification of the generic societal need and associated readiness aspects

srl.label: Solution concept & impacts formulated
srl.description: Formulation of proposed solution concept and potential impacts; appraisal of societal readiness issues; identification of relevant stakeholders for the development of the solution

srl.label: Initial societal exposure
srl.description: Initial sharing of the proposed solution with relevant stakeholders (e.g. through visual mock-ups): a limited group of the society knows the solution or similar initiatives

srl.label: Controlled societal validation
srl.description: Solution validated through pilot testing in controlled environments to substantiate proposed impacts and societal readiness: a limited group of the society tests the solution or similar initiatives

srl.label: Realistic stakeholder validation
srl.description: Solution validated through pilot testing in real or realistic environments and by relevant stakeholders: the society knows the solution or similar initiatives but is not aware of their benefits

srl.label: Real-world societal demonstration
srl.description: Solution demonstrated in real world environments and in co‐operation with relevant stakeholders to gain feedback on potential impacts: the society knows the solution or similar initiatives and awareness of their benefits increases

srl.label: Societal refinement and emerging uptake
srl.description: Refinement of the solution and, if needed, retesting in real world environments with relevant stakeholders: the society is completely aware of the solution's benefits, a part of the society starts to adopt similar solutions

srl.label: Ready for societal embedding
srl.description: Targeted solution, as well as a plan for societal adaptation, complete and qualified; society is ready to adopt the solution and have used similar solutions on the market

srl.label: Societally embedded operational solution
srl.description: Actual solution proven in relevant societal environments after launch on the market; the society is using the solution available on the market
